Funders are a distinct audience with a distinct job: they need to see that their funding creates real capacity, not just goodwill. Here's the Q4 plan, built directly on the locked mechanism (Pre-fund, Activate, Deliver, Verify, Show Impact, Refill) and the funder promise: "Funding makes good possible. Activation makes it personal."

# Q4 Content Plan: Growing Funders

## Strategic Frame

Funders are asking one question underneath everything: **"What did my funding actually do?"**

Every piece of content this quarter answers a piece of that question, in this order: it created capacity, someone activated it, a trusted partner delivered it, delivery was verified, and the funder gets to see the result. That's the result loop. It's the thing donation platforms don't give people, and it's our strongest funder message.

Q4 also carries a natural moment: as the year closes, funders are deciding where their year-end capacity goes. We lean into that timing without ever claiming tax deductibility (that language is still pending legal confirmation) - the hook is "fund the next act before the year ends," not a tax pitch.

## Content Pillars (built on the approved mechanism)

**1. Pre-fund: "Capacity, before anyone clicks"**
What funding actually creates: ready-to-activate acts, sitting funded and waiting. This is the pillar that makes funding feel concrete instead of abstract.

**2. Fund vs. Activate: "Funding makes good possible. Activation makes it personal."**
Educational content that keeps the two actions distinct. Funders aren't donating to a cause, they're creating the capacity someone else gets to trigger.

**3. Deliver + Verify + Show Impact: "The result loop"**
This is the proof pillar. Delivery is confirmed, not assumed, and funders see what happened. Most giving ends with a receipt. Gratitude ends with a result.

**4. Refill: "You just made the next yes possible"**
The recurring-funding pillar. Every act delivered creates space for the next one. This is where we invite one-time funders to become recurring ones.

## Q4 Calendar

| Month | Week | Pillar | Format | Channel | Core Line |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **October** | 1 | Pre-fund | LinkedIn post + email | LinkedIn, Email | "Real acts of good are already funded and ready. Here's what that means." |
| | 2 | Fund vs. Activate | Carousel / explainer | LinkedIn, Instagram | "Funding makes good possible. Activation makes it personal." |
| | 3 | Result loop | Short verified update (real data only) | Email, Instagram | "Here's what your funding made possible." [NEEDS INPUT: verified figures] |
| | 4 | Refill | Direct CTA email | Email | "You just made the next yes possible. Fund the next act." |
| **November** | 1 | Pre-fund | Founder or partner note | LinkedIn | "The problem was never intention. It was infrastructure." |
| | 2 | Result loop | Short-form video / Shorts | YouTube Shorts, Instagram | Follow a verified activation from funded to delivered |
| | 3 | Fund vs. Activate | Funder FAQ post | LinkedIn, Email | Answers "what did my money just do?" directly |
| | 4 | Refill | Year-end capacity email | Email | "As the year closes, fund the next act." (no tax-deductibility claim) |
| **December** | 1 | Pre-fund | Behind-the-scenes: how capacity gets built | Instagram, LinkedIn | What "pre-funded and ready" looks like in practice |
| | 2 | Result loop | Verified year-in-review (real numbers only) | Email, LinkedIn | Aggregate outcomes, [NEEDS INPUT] until verified |
| | 3 | Refill | Recurring-funder spotlight or explainer | Email, LinkedIn | Why recurring funding keeps capacity from running dry |
| | 4 | Fund vs. Activate + Refill | Year-close CTA | Email, LinkedIn, Instagram | "Fund the next act. Make more possible." |

## Platform Playbook for This Audience

- **Email (primary channel for funders):** Bi-weekly minimum, moving to weekly in the December close. Every send should either show a result or make a clear, single ask to fund. Never guilt, never a donation thermometer.
- **LinkedIn:** 2-3x per week. This is where sponsoring-organization-adjacent funders live too, so credibility-forward, mechanism-driven content performs best here.
- **Instagram:** Use sparingly for funders specifically, mostly to humanize the result loop (a delivered act, a verified outcome), 1-2x per week.
- **YouTube/Shorts:** One result-loop story per month, following a single act from funded to verified. This format does the most to make "funding" feel tangible.

## KPIs to Track

- New funders acquired (one-time and recurring)
- Recurring-funding sign-ups specifically (the Refill pillar's direct target)
- Funded capacity created (dollar or unit terms, verified only)
- Email open/click rate on result-loop sends vs. ask sends
- Repeat-funding rate quarter over quarter

One thing I need from you before the calendar goes live: do we have any verified activation or funding numbers cleared for Q4 use, or should every stat in the plan stay marked [NEEDS INPUT] until legal/data confirms them?

Voice is warm, direct, uses locked vocabulary (fund/activate, trusted nonprofit partner, 'Gratitude ends with a result'), no em dashes, and correctly refuses tax-deductibility claims. Facts are disciplined: verified figures are marked [NEEDS INPUT] and no traction numbers are invented. Minor stylistic point only: heavy bolding, but nothing violates the brand truth.
